purpose: Qualify exact-prefix retention separately for Qwen 3.5 2B, 4B, 9B and LFM 2.5 2.6B, separating sampling variation from state-reuse regressions.
baseline: Current reviewed application loop and profile, with cross-request caching disabled. Same source, helper, sampler settings and tools in both arms.
candidate: Existing exact-token-prefix snapshot implementation. Checkpoint-native prefill remains unchanged. No model-specific prompts or output filters.

quality.seedScope: The native sampler is reset to the specified seed for each generation, after loading. App sampling remains unseeded. Both arms use identical production temperatures, token budgets and tool definitions.
quality.review: Inspect complete answers, delivered instructions/tools, rejected calls and persisted facts; aggregate scores alone cannot conceal a lost write.

acceptance: Snapshot restoration matches independently recomputed split-prefill state. Investigate differences from ordinary unsplit prefill; do not claim bitwise equivalence when native chunk shapes differ.

No lost expected write, unsupported personal assertion, incorrect correction or tool-protocol regression versus paired baseline. Failure is investigated in integration first; unresolved regressions keep the profile disabled.
At least 20% median warm first-text improvement over ten matched greedy pairs, with all known-answer controls correct. Report initial no-prefix costs separately.
Cancellation, sink failure, session release, changed inputs and growing-prefix capacity controls pass. At most one bounded snapshot; no cross-companion state.
One candidate per model. At most one targeted diagnostic replay per observed discrepancy; no prompt tuning on test answers. Stop a model on an unresolved mandatory failure or the execution budget.
reviewer: Implementing agent, not independent human review
publication: Preserve raw failures, hashes, budgets and skipped cases. These targeted results do not replace the full benchmark leaderboard. No push or app restart.
